entities.name: Masnavi
entities.label: Text
entities.summary: The Masnavi is an extensive Persian masnavi written by Rumi, and one of the most influential works in the history of Sufism. It is a series of six books of poetry that together amount to around 25,000 verses or 50,000 lines.
